caption: The drawing depicts a decorative drawstring bag with a scalloped top edge. The bag has a pink and white striped, gathered upper section, tied with pink ribbon drawstrings on each side. The main body of the bag is predominantly white and is decorated with a large blue bird, a red rose, green leaves, and a small red flower in a central, stylized folk-art pattern. Below this, there is a horizontal dark red band with triangular edges, beneath which is a scene featuring four small houses in colors blue, red, yellow, and white, set against a green background with a tree to the right. The bottom of the bag has long blue decorative fringe. The entire composition is framed by a thin pencil border on an off-white background, and a small embossed seal is visible in the upper left corner of the paper. The words "Actual Size" are written in pencil at the lower right of the drawing.
title: Purse
